title: Concerning the National Collegiate Athletic Association policy for eligibility in women's sports.
latestAction: Referred to the House Committee on Education and Workforce.
summary: This resolution calls on the National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA) to revoke its transgender student-athlete eligibility policy and urges the NCAA to require its member conferences to conform to a biological sex-based policy across all sports and all divisions.

actions.text: Referred to the House Committee on Education and Workforce.
